carlingiti: They issued Otto Carlingiti a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a bullet that missed him in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Otto Carlingiti was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F12 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
An empty jam tin became Otto Carlingiti's cup. The first drink tasted faintly of strawberries. He took smaller sips than usual.
